description: Projects, boards and lists with their IDs. The source of the IDs every other tool needs. Columns cost one board read per board: pass withLists: false for the projects and boards alone, in a single request.

withLists.description: Include each board's columns. Default true; false answers projects and boards in one request (planka_board_summary also lists the columns, with their counts).
